summary: Iteration 6: tested the 3 new features (audit trail webhook events, per-UBO Didit KYC session + webhook branch, branded PDF) plus regressions. Created /app/backend/tests/test_iter6_audit_and_ubo.py with 20 tests — ALL 20 PASS. Prior suites still pass (27/27 in test_pdf_and_webhook.py + test_didit_and_regressions.py). Frontend Playwright end-to-end: registered applicant, created app with 2 directors, fired UBO webhook (dir:0 Approved), logged in via UI, opened application detail — verified: director-kyc-0/1 buttons render, KYC:Approved badge on Alice, 'Audit Trail Webhook (1)' list shows status.updated · Approved · UBO with received_at timestamp, clicking Verifikasi KYC triggers toast 'Didit belum dikonfigurasi (API key kosong)'.
critical_code_review_comments: didit_webhook now inserts EVERY inbound event into db.didit_events BEFORE signature check — good for audit fidelity. verified flag captures signature state per-event. Consider TTL/index on (app_id, received_at) if volume grows; currently list capped at 200 via to_list(200).
Per-UBO branch (':dir:' in vendor_data) correctly updates only director_kyc[idx] and does NOT touch app.status/decision. Guard for finalized app on app-level branch remains intact.
director_kyc_session uses DIDIT_KYC_WORKFLOW_ID fallback (separate from app-level DIDIT_WORKFLOW_ID) — clean separation for KYC vs KYB flow templates.
vendor_data parsing uses str.split(':dir:') so an app id that itself contains ':dir:' would collide. Application IDs are generated 'app_<hex>' so safe today, but consider stricter delimiter/regex.

director_kyc entry keyed by string index (str(i)) — consistent across create-session flow and webhook branch; frontend reads dirKyc[i] with numeric key — verified working via Playwright (badge rendered for i=0).
server.py now 1110 lines; refactor into routers still recommended.
PDF letterhead+footer via canvas onFirstPage/onLaterPages callback; visually verified by main agent.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (per-UBO KYC button + status badge + audit-trail list + toast all verified)
